title: PyTorch Introduction — A Number Container That Knows Its Shape
key_insight: A PyTorch tensor is an arranged block of numbers with a shape, data type, and device such as CPU or GPU.
body:
## A Number Container That Knows Its Shape

A training program needs to hold batches of images and move them to fast hardware without rewriting every calculation.

A PyTorch tensor is an arranged block of numbers with a shape, data type, and device such as CPU or GPU.

Tensor operations build model calculations. Print shape, dtype, and device often; most early framework bugs become obvious there.
common_mistakes: A tensor can contain only one number.
An nn.Module prevents parameters from being trained.
Autograd requires every derivative to be entered by hand.
mini_exercise: Sketch the situation in “A Number Container That Knows Its Shape” as three labeled steps, then explain what changes at each step.
real_world_usage: PyTorch turns the phase’s equations into inspectable, trainable programs.
explain_back_prompt: Using the “A Number Container That Knows Its Shape” situation, explain PyTorch Introduction without assuming the listener knows deep learning.
